Protein Food

Lamb Neck

About This Entry

Lamb neck is a flavorful, sinewy cut prized in stews and slow braises. Collagen and fat release deep lamb character — pairing territory for rustic reds, southern French blends, and aged Rioja.

Beginner Guide

Neck may be sold on the bone or as sliced fillets. Long cooking is mandatory; the reward is intense, unctuous meat.

FAQ

What is Lamb Neck?
Neck may be sold on the bone or as sliced fillets.
How should Lamb Neck be cooked for best results?
Match cooking method to cut — quick heat for tender muscles, slow moist heat for collagen-rich cuts. Rest roasts before slicing.
